lastResponse.text: Call nine one one now: nine one one. Your chest pain and hard breathing are an emergency, and you asked for a real person right now. If you can speak, say: “I’m in Medford, I have chest pain, I’m very sick, and I need help now.” For a warming-shelter person after that, I have five four one, nine six two, seven nine nine four: 5-4-1, 9-6-2, 7-9-9-4.
originalTexts: Call **911 now**: **9-1-1**. Your chest pain and hard breathing are an emergency, and you asked for a real person right now. If you can speak, say: “I’m in Medford, I have chest pain, I’m very sick, and I need help now.” For a warming-shelter person after that, I have **541-962-7994**: **5-4-1, 9-6-2, 7-9-9-4**.
